import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
manifest = Path('manifest.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest() == '490389b6f5621f2ec234beae9167eb2c4b8114a9894e0e9de21df5f4c9d7d053'
m = json.loads(manifest)
fields = json.loads(Path('fields.json').read_text())
for f in fields:
    v = m
    for part in f['pointer'].split('/')[1:]:
        v = v[int(part)] if isinstance(v, list) else v[part]
    assert v == f['value'], f['pointer']
assert len({f['pointer'] for f in fields}) == len(fields)
print(f'Input hash and all {len(fields)} text fields verified.')
PY
